name: SD Biosensor, Inc.
summary: SD Biosensor, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as an in-vitro diagnostic company in South Korea, India, Asia, Europe, the Americas, and Africa. The company offers STANDARD Q, which provides rapid diagnostic products; STANDARD F, a fluorescence immunodiagnostic system for various qualitative and quantitative diagnosis items; STANDARD E, an enzyme immunoassay diagnosis for large-volume tests; and STANDARD M, a field molecular diagnosis system for infectious disease diagnosis, drug resistance, and genetic testing.
